project_type: Next.js 15 App Router full-stack application with tRPC, Drizzle ORM, BullMQ workers
build_system: Next.js build via node_modules/.bin/next, bun for package management (but use nvm node for running commands)
test_framework: Vitest with jsdom environment, tests in __tests__ directories alongside source
verification_instructions: 1. Run build command. 2. Run test command. 3. Run tsc: export PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v24.16.0/bin:$PATH" && ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
environment_constraints: mise is NOT trusted - use nvm node directly. SKIP_ENV_VALIDATION=1 needed for builds. No real DB connection. .next must be cleared before builds when switching branches. lucide-react 1.x is currently installed and working - downgrading to 0.x will break icon imports. next@16.2.9 works currently.
contribution_requirements: Do NOT delete/overwrite migration SQL files in /drizzle/. Do NOT rewrite migration journal. Do NOT replace mock-db implementations. Do NOT change shadcn/ui visual structure. Do NOT change route paths. Do NOT introduce new npm packages. Do NOT auto-fix unsafe Biome errors. Do NOT touch src/server/services/mock-db.ts.
key_patterns: tRPC routers in src/server/routers/ with protectedProcedure/engineerProcedure. Drizzle schema in src/lib/db/schema/ (one file per table). isDeleted uses integer(0/1) pattern throughout. Share links use integer for boolean flags. DB pool is configurable via env vars. Workers use BullMQ with Redis.
directory_structure: src/app/(protected)/ - protected pages, src/server/routers/ - tRPC routers, src/lib/db/schema/ - Drizzle schema files, src/workers/ - BullMQ workers, src/components/ - UI components (layout, shared, ui, providers), scripts/ - utility scripts, drizzle/ - migration SQL files (DO NOT modify)
